claims.value: Ararat Revolt of 1930: HCD records Turkey in an intrastate conflict during 1930.

scope.description: State-associated named intrastate conflict; no claim of uniform polygon-wide fighting or a precise daily chronology.

evidence.note: Original country-war min_year and max_year both1930; annual intra_war=1, named Ararat Revolt of1930. Source definition requires a war-scale conflict; this named government/revolt conflict was selected in bounded review, not every dataset record. No exact day, participant entry/exit or casualty precision invented.

qualifications: HCD conflict coding; original year precision retained. No claim that the broader revolt first began in1930.
Selected named conflict has direct country/snapshot relevance; no generic global-history filler.

provenance.method: Complete HCD source inspected. Only the named Ararat intrastate conflict in1930 selected: direct Turkey affiliation, both source years1930, no external participant confusion, existing reviewed Turkey framework covers full1930. HCD war threshold and original named revolt establish meaningful political-event relevance. Multi-year country participation leakage, competing frameworks and unreviewed aliases remain held. Official CC BY-SA country-year licence confirmed in current DEMSCORE section3.1. Preserve original dates and qualitative coding; no raw COW republication.
